summary_md:
# #449 Finansmedias creme de la creme

**Feed**: market-makers  
**Published**: 2026-09-17  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The hosts discuss escalating Middle East turmoil: Houthis controlling Bab el-Mandeb, damage to the Saudi East-West pipeline and oil prices surging to record tanker rates, while the stock market sits near all-time highs, helped by AI. One host is holding cash through a seasonally weak September. They discuss Microsoft's margin pressure as revenue moves from licences to consumption, and what that could mean for Nordic IT resellers and consultants. On individual stocks, one host added to US refiner Calumet, another bought a small position in Remedy ahead of Control Resonant, and all three own Hacksaw, which has strong buying flows from Capital Group and Kenneth Dart.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 HACK — Hacksaw | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 75%

Host sold, then bought back everything the next day because Capital Group and Kenneth Dart are buying heavily. Plans to ride the flows and trim before Q3.

#### Reasoning

Capital Group bought 1% in Aug and 2% in early Sep, the same aggressive pattern as its Evolution build. Kenneth Dart has ~154m SEK in Hacksaw, tiny against a >100bn net worth, so more buying is likely. Also defensive against Hormuz turmoil. Caliente is a big new client. Negatives: tough Q3 comparisons, possibly high analyst estimates, weak new-game reviews, and the largest OpenRGS client leaving.

#### Sell Triggers

- a few days before the Q3 report (planned trim)
- if Capital Group/Dart buying stops
- if more large OpenRGS clients leave
- if Q3 misses elevated estimates

> *"Så att flödesbilden är extremt positivt tycker jag i Haxo just nu."*

---

### 🟢 CLMT — Calumet | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Host added more. Base-oil windfall until H2 2027 should let it repay nearly all repayable debt, which makes the bull case more likely.

#### Reasoning

Industry experts see base oil prices staying high until H2 2027, which matches the timeline Calumet needs to pay off repayable debt. The biofuels segment has a lasting tailwind: blending mandates plus surplus US crops after China diversified away. The host sees good risk/reward but expects volatility.

#### Sell Triggers

- if base oil prices normalise before H2 2027
- if debt paydown stalls
- if biofuel mandates weaken

> *"Och därmed är ju bull caset mer sannolikt än bara för någon månad sedan."*

---

### 🟢 REMEDY — Remedy Entertainment | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 55%

Niklas bought a small position ahead of the Control Resonant reviews and the Sep 24 launch. Self-publishing gives better margins; more than 1.5M wishlists.

#### Reasoning

Catalysts are the review scores and the launch. It is self-published on all platforms including Steam (Alan Wake 2 was Epic-exclusive), so margins are better. Publishing rights to the original Control are back, so sales could spill over. A successful launch would prove the self-publishing model; the Max Payne remakes with Rockstar come later. Risks: sell-on-news, and competition in the crowded September window before GTA 6.

#### Sell Triggers

- if reviews/Metacritic are weak
- if sell-on-news reaction
- if launch sales disappoint due to competition before GTA 6

> *"Så jag tycker det är en lite spännande sits i det här bolaget. Jag har ingen jätteposition i det här"*

---

### ⛔ OET — Okeanis Eco Tankers | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Up 20% in a week on record VLCC rates, but the host won't chase: likely peak earnings and poor visibility on how long rates last.

#### Reasoning

The host briefly owned it this year and says the upside isn't worth the stress. Tankers are up about 50% since summer, and the time to buy was earlier. It's a peak-earnings risk.

> *"Men jag har väl kommit fram till att jag har för dålig insyn just nu."*

---

### 🟠 TTWO — Take-Two Interactive | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

GTA 6 is due in October, but it's seen as too obvious a trade. The stock has fallen and one host wonders if it's an entry point.

#### Reasoning

Everyone expects GTA 6 to succeed, so it's likely priced in. One host thinks the company overall doesn't work that well. Weak interest in buying after the drop.

#### Sell Triggers

- if GTA 6 is delayed

> *"Take 2 är så fruktansvärt stort och jag tror att det är en för uppenbar trade."*

---

### 🟠 MSFT — Microsoft | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Margins are pressured as revenue shifts from fixed licences to Azure consumption. The stock lags the Nasdaq; it has raised its dividend for 25 years.

#### Reasoning

The host flags the margin trend as worth tracking: unused Copilot licences were nearly pure profit, while consumption pricing gives lower margins. It's only a modest issue for Microsoft itself.

#### Sell Triggers

- if margin compression accelerates

> *"Jag tycker att det är en trend som kan vara värd att hålla koll på"*

---

### 🟠 DUST — Dustin | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

The shift to consumption pricing could cut licence reseller commissions and make revenue less predictable.

#### Reasoning

Microsoft moving to consumption pricing hits resellers further down the chain: lower commissions, harder sales and more volatile revenue.

> *"Då kan vi titta på bolag som till exempel Dustin på svenska börsen"*
